mainEntity.name: How often should I review AI workflows used across several business projects?

acceptedAnswer.text: Ongoing support should include periodic checks of facts, prompts, integrations, permissions, costs, output quality, and business results. Review more often when a project, platform, offer, or process changes, and less often after the workflow has demonstrated stability. Keep a simple maintenance record showing what changed, why it changed, and whether the next run passed. Key measures include correction rate, failure rate, time saved, duplicate work, and customer-facing errors. Run My AI Biz’s educational model encourages refinement over time, which is necessary because a reusable prompt can become inaccurate as the business evolves.
acceptedAnswer.description: Review prompts, facts, integrations, permissions, costs, output quality, and results regularly, with extra checks after any business or platform change. Track corrections, failures, time saved, duplicate work, and customer-facing errors in a simple maintenance record.
